_pricing_note: Rates move. Re-fetch before every run; a stale rate is worse than no rate because it looks authoritative.
_maxTokens_note: 400, not 120. A reasoning model can spend an entire small cap on hidden reasoning and return an empty visible completion — which is exactly how this study lost its most flattering result (128 of 192 replies empty). Size the cap for the model, then check the parse-miss count before believing anything.
